chapters.reason: The paper proposes a prompting framework that uses linguistic constraints and modular paradigms to reduce token usage at inference time, which aligns perfectly with the definition of length budgeting.

The framework uses a lightweight routing model to dynamically select reasoning paradigms (Conceptual Chaining, Chunked Symbolism, etc.) at test-time, functioning as a switch between different reasoning modes.
The paper extensively evaluates the trade-offs between reasoning accuracy and computational token costs across 18 datasets, contributing to the measurement of reasoning efficiency.
